project_info.theme: Shimmering red-carpet portrait of two adult actresses

main_subject.detail: two adult blonde actresses standing close together arm-in-arm, smiling gently and confidently toward the camera with poised elegance and sisterly warmth
main_subject.left_wardrobe: sleeveless metallic gold lamé gown with a softly draped cowl bodice, floor-length fitted mermaid silhouette, and gentle train, with a minimalist gold ring

composition_elements.framing: symmetrical vertical portrait centered on both faces and upper bodies, with optional three-quarter crop

composition_elements.background: glamorous indoor gala with starry twinkling bokeh, soft golden ambient glow, and a generic blurred event sign without real award branding

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: cinematic volumetric key light with soft warm rim light at approximately 3800K to 4500K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: soft rim on hair and shoulders, subtle eye catchlights, realistic fabric sheen, gentle facial modeling, and elegant dark-background separation

technical_specs.render_style: professional event camera with 85mm lens, polished red-carpet editorial photography
technical_specs.finish: photorealistic detail, visible skin pores, restrained highlights, natural fabric texture, subtle film grain

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-detailed cinematic red-carpet portrait photograph at a fictional critics-awards-style gala in a glamorous indoor venue, with dramatic starry twinkling bokeh lights and soft golden ambient glow in the deep dark background. Two clearly adult blonde actresses stand close together arm-in-arm, smiling gently and confidently directly at the camera with poised elegance and sisterly warmth. The left adult woman has straight silky platinum-blonde hair cascading past her shoulders and wears a sleeveless metallic gold lamé gown with a softly draped cowl bodice, floor-length fitted mermaid silhouette, gentle train, and minimalist gold ring. The right adult woman has voluminous wavy golden-blonde hair in an elegant half-up style with loose face-framing tendrils and wears a high-fashion white satin ball gown with a structured fitted bodice, dramatic black velvet-trimmed scoop neckline, wide velvet waist band, exaggerated peplum hip detail, voluminous floor-length A-line skirt, and large pearl drop earrings. Use symmetrical composition centered on their faces and upper bodies, professional event photography, soft rim light on hair and shoulders, subtle catchlights, realistic skin pores, fabric sheen, photorealistic detail, an 85mm lens, and no real award branding or recognizable public-figure likeness.
